caseNameFull: Joseph B. Beutel v. Oscar G. Foreman, Trustees, etc.

opinions.text: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Illinois. January 19, 1921. Dismissed with costs, pursuant to the tenth rule. Mr. Albert Fink and Mr. David D. Stansbury for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Samuel A. Ettelson and Mr. Chester E. Cleveland for defendants in error.
